description: Config for behavioral instructions by hook type. UserPromptSubmit/SessionStart use text file references (long-form). PostToolUse uses inline trigger-based messages (short, contextual, just-in-time).

working-protocol.description: Mandatory cognitive procedures (meta-awareness, think-and-act, decide, verify-work)

model-orchestration.description: External model delegation and PAC-5 checkpoint

workflow-adherence.description: Ensure agent follows CLAUDE.md workflows and skill invocations

memory-progress.description: Periodic instruction to record work progress (decisions, milestones, user requirements)

memory-work-start.description: UserPromptSubmit: invoke begin-work when starting meaningful work (L1 enforced for branch creation)

memory-complete-work.description: UserPromptSubmit: invoke complete-work before commits (L1 enforced cross-skill prerequisite)

session-start-procedure.description: Enforce CLAUDE.md Section 2 Session Start procedure

PostToolUse._description: Contextual just-in-time instructions triggered after specific tool operations. Uses inline messages with pattern matching. Different from UserPromptSubmit which fires at message start - these fire at the moment of action.

messages.Edit: MANDATORY: You edited a .md file. Skill('cf-documentation-standards', args='lint-file') NOW. FORBIDDEN: Proceeding without lint validation.
messages.Write: MANDATORY: New .md file created. VERIFY you invoked Skill('cf-documentation-standards', args='apply-standard') BEFORE creation. FORBIDDEN: Creating .md files without skill invocation.

messages.Edit: MANDATORY: You edited a .sh file. Skill('cf-script-standards', args='lint-shell') NOW. FORBIDDEN: Committing without shellcheck validation.
messages.Write: MANDATORY: New .sh file created. VERIFY you invoked Skill('cf-script-standards', args='apply-shell-standards') BEFORE creation. FORBIDDEN: Creating scripts without skill invocation.

messages.Edit: MANDATORY: You edited a .py file. Skill('cf-script-standards', args='lint-python') NOW. FORBIDDEN: Committing without flake8 validation.
messages.Write: MANDATORY: New .py file created. VERIFY you invoked Skill('cf-script-standards', args='apply-python-standards') BEFORE creation. FORBIDDEN: Creating scripts without skill invocation.

messages.Edit: INVENTORY: If script purpose/dependencies changed, UPDATE docs/reference/project-scripts-inventory.md. Do NOT skip for significant changes.
messages.Write: INVENTORY REQUIRED: New script MUST be added to docs/reference/project-scripts-inventory.md. FORBIDDEN: Leaving new scripts undocumented.

messages.Edit: INVENTORY: If script purpose/dependencies changed, UPDATE docs/reference/project-scripts-inventory.md. Do NOT skip for significant changes.
messages.Write: INVENTORY REQUIRED: New script MUST be added to docs/reference/project-scripts-inventory.md. FORBIDDEN: Leaving new scripts undocumented.

script-inventory-update.note: Ensures project-scripts-inventory.md stays in sync with script changes

messages.Write: TESTING REQUIRED: New script created. Skill('cf-script-standards', args='ensure-test-coverage') NOW. FORBIDDEN: Committing scripts without tests.
messages.Edit: TESTING REMINDER: Script edited. Consider Skill('cf-script-standards', args='ensure-test-coverage') if behavior changed. Tests should cover new/changed functionality.

messages.Write: TESTING REQUIRED: New Python script created. Skill('cf-script-standards', args='ensure-test-coverage') NOW. FORBIDDEN: Committing scripts without tests.
messages.Edit: TESTING REMINDER: Python script edited. Consider Skill('cf-script-standards', args='ensure-test-coverage') if behavior changed. Tests should cover new/changed functionality.

script-test-coverage.note: Fires when creating or editing scripts - ensures test coverage consideration

code-exploration-lsp.message: TIP: For Python symbol searches, prefer LSP tools (get_definition, get_references) over Grep for semantic accuracy. Skill('cf-code-exploration', args='...') for guidance.

git-worktree-status.message: TIP: Consider Skill('cf-git-workflow', args='list-worktrees') for status tracking with metadata.

git-commit-memory.message: JUST-IN-TIME MEMORY SYNC: You are about to commit. Skill('cf-memory-management', args='complete-work') NOW if not already done. FORBIDDEN: Committing without memory sync.
git-commit-memory.note: Fires at commit time - UserPromptSubmit reminder may have been minutes/hours ago

Stop._description: Block messages shown when Stop hook blocks agent completion. Dynamic parts (attempt X/Y, missing elements) handled by script, static instruction text from file.

verify-work-block.description: Instruction shown when verify-work is missing - directs to skill invocation
